name: Mâche (Corn salad)

schedule.notes: Doesn't tolerate heat — best in shoulder seasons and winter.
Fall sowings overwinter under mulch or row cover in zones 5+ for late-winter harvests.
Snip whole rosettes at the base when 2 to 3 in across, before flower stalk.

harvest.cues: Tight rosette of paddle-shaped leaves, 2 to 3 in across, no flower stalk. Nutty-sweet flavor.
harvest.storageNotes: Wraps in damp paper, fridge 3 to 5 days. Best fresh.

varieties.name: Vit
varieties.notes: Larger leaves, slightly faster. Standard for fresh markets.

varieties.name: Verte de Cambrai
varieties.notes: Small dark green leaves, intense flavor. The traditional French type.

notes: Cold-hardy salad green of last resort — gives you fresh leaves in February when nothing else is alive. Self-seeds if you let one rosette flower.
